headline: Public hearing on Heli Corp's application to take over a liquor license and move it to 790 Main Street.
summary: Interested parties will be heard on a request by Heli Corp, dba Dandea's Superette. The request would transfer a package store license from Vishwaraja Crop, dba Jay's Fine Wine & Sprits, and change its location from 77 Commercial Street to 790 Main Street.
items: Public hearing on the application of Heli Corp, dba Dandea's Superette
Transfer of license to sell all alcoholic beverages as a package store, from Vishwaraja Crop dba Jay's Fine Wine & Sprits
Change of location from 77 Commercial Street to 790 Main Street
location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St, Room 108
plain_text:
CITY OF MALDEN 
MASSACHUSETTS 
   
Licensing Board 
Public Notice of Meeting & Agenda 
 
 
Date of Meeting: Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 6 PM 
 
Location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St, Room 108 
 
Meeting Agenda 
 
1. Roll Call 
 
2.  Business to be Considered: 
 
A. A hearing regarding the application of Heli Corp, dba Dandea’s Superette, 
for a Transfer of License to sell all alcoholic beverages as a package store to be 
consumed on premises from Vishwaraja Crop dba Jay’s Fine Wine & Sprits 
currently being exercised at 77 Commercial Street and for a Change of 
Location from 77 Commercial Street to 790 Main Street. 
3. Adjournment 
 
 
All interested parties will be given opportunity to be heard. 
 
Kevin Molis, Chairman 
Andrew Zeiberg, Member 
Denise Balboni-Cowie, Member 
 
To request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at 
mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781.397.7000, Ext. 2005
